# Chinese International Industry Fair


## Oct 12 to 17
Shanghai, China
National Exhibition and Convention Center


## Discover Our Solutions for Photonics and Collaborative Robots Application


Join Advanced Energy at CIIF 2026 where we will be showcasing precision AC‑DC and DC‑DC power solutions engineered for next‑generation photonics systems and industrial robotics.


From configurable power platforms to high‑efficiency board‑mounted converters, our portfolio delivers the reliability, accuracy, and performance required to accelerate automation and optical innovation.


Visit our booth to explore how AE’s technologies shorten development cycles, enhance system stability, and support rapid integration across demanding industrial environments.
